data.name: Jeevika
data.gender_notes: Jeevika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jeevika is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jeev' meaning 'life'. The suffix 'ka' denotes the feminine gender. In Hindu mythology, the goddess of life is often personified as Aditi, the mother of all gods. Thus, Jeevika is a name that symbolizes the nurturing and sustaining power of life. The name Jeevika carries the meaning “Goddess of Life” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jeevika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the divine essence of life.
data.etymology: Jeevika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jeevika total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
